info.name: Payment Gateway Api
info.description:
## Request Headers | Parameter Name | Header Value | | --- | --- | | **x-api-key** | Will be shared by asianpay | | **Content-Type** | application/json | **Note:** Unique MerchantID assigned to the merchant by asianpay. ### **API LIST :** 1. Initiate Payment 2. Check Payment Status First you need to call the **Initiate Payment Api**. For the field level details refer to below mentioned table. In this api you will have to provide the payment mode as INTENT **Once you will get the response save the order_id and we will send the callback to your endpoint which you have send in initiate payment you can make reconcile the transaction based on that.** For callback payload please refer below. ## **Request Parameters (**Properties). | Parameter Name | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | TransactionId | STRING | Unique TransactionID generated by the merchant to track request to asianpay

Note:
\- Max Length 50 char..

\- No Special characters allowed except underscore "_" | | merchantTransactionId | STRING | Customer ref number | | merchantId | STRING | Unique MerchantID assigned to the merchant. | | amount | LONG | Transaction amount. | | payment_for | STRING | Payment Remarks | | customer_email | STRING | Email of the user | | customer_phone | STRING | Mobile number of the user | | order_id | STRING | Unique order id generated by asianpay. it will be used to check the status of transaction. | | intent_url | STRING | INTENT string for payment. | | payment_currency | STRING | INR | | order_status | STRING | **FAILED / PAID** | | bank_reference | STRING | bank reference number | | payment_mode | STRING | QR | | callback_url | URL | The url (POST) where server to server callback will be posted. | | | | | **WEBHOOK PAYLOAD** { "order_id": "ASIANPAY_001", "payment_currency": "INR", "order_status": "PAID", "order_amount": 2.0, "payment_method": "UPI", "payment_time": "2023-11-18 02:24:25 PM", "bank_reference": "332298272766", "payment_message": "Transaction Successful", "merchantTransactionId": "MER0014585" }
